newsitem.title: USA: Reynolds to reorganize corporate structure.
newsitem.headline: Reynolds to reorganize corporate structure.

text.p: The Reynolds and Reynolds Co said Wednesday it will reorganize its corporate structure to achieve aggressive growth.
The company said the Business Systems Division's Automotive Products Group and the Automotive Systems Division will merge into a more focused business unit.

Opportunities in the automotive, healthcare and general business markets had forced it to change its organisation and strengthen strategic planning so it could take advantage of the new prospects and double in size by 2000.
The company said Bob Nevin, formerly president of the Business Systems Division, has been named president of the reorganized Automotive Systems Division.
